name: airwallex-dev
description: Airwallex integration skills for Codex. Code-generation workflows that scaffold, configure, and wire Airwallex APIs into your project.

interface.longDescription: Airwallex integration skills for Codex. Generate the checkout, card element, onboarding and subscription billing code for an Airwallex integration, wired into your own project. Covers the Hosted Payment Page, Drop-in and Split Card elements, connected account KYC, and Billing Hosted Checkout, and plans card-on-file merchant-initiated flows for AI providers.
defaultPrompt: Add an Airwallex Hosted Payment Page checkout to my app
Embed the Drop-in element with Apple Pay and Google Pay
Build a custom card form with the Split Card elements
Set up a subscription with Billing Hosted Checkout and a free trial
